notes: *counsel* is `added`: `שָׁאַל` is the asking and *Ask* has already written it, which is rule 44's own example.
The interrogative `הֲ` heads an indirect question under *that we may know* and takes *whether* (rule 17); `נָא` takes the complete formula *we pray thee*, headed on *pray* (rule 30).
`עָלֶיהָ` is unrendered beside the bare *which*: the relative pronoun carries the resumption, so the preposition and suffix are each unrepresented (rules 22, 40).
